% Pattern: head/case. "{\it Case} 1: ..." writes the number of the case after
% the font group of its title. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-1
% want head-1 other/case 1
% want head-2 other/case 2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\begin{lemma} Every finite space is compact. \end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
Let $x$ be a point.

{\it Case} 1: $x=0$. Then the claim is clear.

{\it Case} 2: $x\neq 0$. Then the claim is clear too.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
